title: The Stowaway Assassin
logline: A stowaway on a long-haul transport realizes they are trapped with a contract killer, and hires a pilot to cover their escape on a stolen skiff.

roles.description: Terrified, constantly whispering, hiding in a ventilation shaft.
A massive, slow-moving passenger liner crossing deep space.
A stealthy, unmarked interceptor docked to the liner.
A highly professional syndicate of hitmen.

public_situation: The {role:long_haul_transport} is halfway through a six-month journey across deep space, completely cut off from help.
private_truth: The killer is methodically hunting the stowaway, who accidentally witnessed the killer murder a planetary official before boarding.

beats.public_change: The killer begins quietly locking down the transport's civilian decks one by one.

missions.reason: The stowaway begs the pilot to buy and deliver thermal cloaks to the transport's refuelling stop so they can hide from the killer's scanners.
missions.private_fact: The assassin infiltrated the freight hauler under false credentials to eliminate an eyewitness to a high-profile dockside murder.

beats.public_change: The killer finds the stowaway's hiding spot and prepares to breach it.

missions.reason: The killer hires the pilot (pretending to be station security) to run a deep scan of the transport to pinpoint the stowaway's exact location.
missions.private_fact: The assassin is impersonating a station security lieutenant to access docking sensors and track down the fleeing witness.

beats.public_change: The stowaway steals a maintenance skiff and makes a desperate break from the cargo airlocks.

missions.reason: The stowaway begs the pilot to intercept and destroy the killer's pursuit ship so their skiff can escape.
missions.private_fact: The killer hails the pilot mid-fight, offering double the bounty to stand down and let the skiff be destroyed.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot destroys the killer's ship, letting the stowaway escape.
resolutions.summary: The stowaway escapes the system in the skiff. The killer's guild holds a grudge.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot smuggled a terrified witness past a professional contract killer.

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot takes the bribe and lets the killer destroy the stowaway.
resolutions.summary: The stowaway's skiff is incinerated. The killer pays out, and the transport resumes normal operations.
The killer corners the stowaway in the airlock and executes them silently. The killer escapes without a trace.

loose_threads.detail: The assassin wasn't hired by the guild; they were hired directly by the planetary governor.
The stowaway admits they aren't completely innocent; they were trying to rob the official when the killer struck.

radio_hooks: Passengers complain of severe delays aboard {role:long_haul_transport}.
Authorities still searching for missing planetary official.

voice_direction.contract_killer: Quiet, extremely polite, never raises their voice.
